about: hxq lint --fix of one rule over a fixture program, then the fixture and the files it started from both compiled and RUN (haxe --interp) with and without -D dflag: a fix must keep what the program prints. Seeded from the redundant-braces review (dangling else through a loop, #if regions, macro returns). D* must be refused, F* fixed.

invocations.name: D1
invocations.note: dangling else through a for body: must be refused

invocations.name: D2
invocations.note: dangling else through a while body: must be refused

invocations.name: D3
invocations.note: nested for in the loop body of an if with else: must be refused

invocations.name: D4
invocations.note: else-less if as a loop body, followed by a statement

invocations.name: D5
invocations.note: #if region statement inside an if branch

invocations.name: D6
invocations.note: an else present only under a define

invocations.name: F1
invocations.note: else-if chain whose every branch can go bare

invocations.name: F2
invocations.note: plain for body

invocations.name: F3
invocations.note: define-switched expression in both branches

invocations.name: F4
invocations.note: break in a loop body

invocations.name: F5
invocations.note: value tail of a block expression

invocations.name: F6
invocations.note: while with a call body

invocations.name: F7
invocations.note: if inside a switch case

invocations.name: F8
invocations.note: return and throw of define-switched values in a function

invocations.name: F9
invocations.note: return macro in a macro function called from main

invocations.name: G1
invocations.note: fmt with symmetric braces over a value-position try whose catch body is a switch expression: no ; may follow the switch inside the inserted wrap

invocations.name: RC1
invocations.note: repeated-cast over each form its review refuted or held: unbraced guard, write in a right side, loop back edge, write and call ahead of the first cast, two runs in one statement; the fix must keep what the program prints

invocations.name: RC2
invocations.note: repeated-cast must not put its local ahead of the statement declaring the operand: with an outer binding of that name it would compile and cast the wrong value

invocations.name: HC1
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-tail over a plain chain, an else-if chain, an emptied final else and a branch that may return early, beside the forms it must leave: a loop body, a tail reading a branch local, a tail that exits; the fix must keep what the program prints

invocations.name: HC2
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-tail on a chain whose kept statement before the shared outer tail is itself a chain with a shared tail: the outer rewrite lands first and the inner waits for the next pass, so no call vanishes

invocations.name: HC3
invocations.note: the same nested shape in the final else of the outer chain

invocations.name: HC4
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-tail on an outer tail that ends in a chain with its own shared tail: the inner chain waits for the outer rewrite, so no call runs a second time

invocations.name: HC5
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-tail on a chain written as a statement with its own semicolon, final else kept and emptied: the moved tail leaves no empty statement for the compiler to refuse

invocations.name: HC6
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-tail on a chain followed by a comment before its own semicolon, block and line form, final else kept and emptied: the tail goes after the semicolon, the emptied form is left alone, and the program compiles and prints the same

invocations.name: HH1
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-head over a plain chain, an else-if chain with a two-statement head, an emptied final else and a constant declaration before a condition that calls a function, beside the forms it must leave: a condition reading what the head writes, a head reading what a calling condition changed, a loop body, a head that exits; the fix must keep what the program prints

invocations.name: HH2
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-head and -tail together on a chain sharing both ends, and on a chain whose head is itself a chain with a shared head: the outer rewrite lands first and the inner waits for the next pass, so no call vanishes or runs twice

invocations.name: HH3
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-head over a chain whose head calls a function that writes the field the condition reads: the head stays in its branches, so the program prints what it printed

invocations.name: HH4
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-head over a chain whose condition reads a property whose getter changes a static the head reads: the head stays in its branches, so the program prints what it printed

invocations.name: N1
invocations.note: naming handlerSuffix: only a callback is a listener - a value-returning onX called directly stays whatever else shares its name (a parameter, another type field, a macro template, a nested function return)

invocations.name: S1
invocations.note: naming catchVarName: two sibling catch clauses both take the configured name in one run; the program still compiles and prints the same

invocations.name: S2
invocations.note: naming catchVarName: a sibling clause already named exception is a disjoint scope, so the half-renamed pair converges to one spelling; the program still compiles and prints the same

invocations.name: MS1
invocations.note: map-as-set --fix declines a growing local set whose name another receiver (other.seen) shares: nothing is respelled, the files stay as written, the program still compiles and prints the same

invocations.name: MS2
invocations.note: map-as-set --fix declines the whole set when a local shares its name with an inherited member read as this.seen: nothing is respelled, the program still compiles and prints the same

invocations.name: PF1
invocations.note: prefer-final, prefer-final-public-field and prefer-inline on a plain class whose file only NAMES a generic-build tag in a comment: all three fire, the comment makes nothing macro-made

invocations.name: H1
invocations.note: hoist-common-branch-tail: an identical-branch chain with plain conditions collapses to one copy (b, c, d); an impure condition with a declaring body (a) and a chain without a final else (e) are refused

invocations.name: S3
invocations.note: naming catchVarName: a sibling block already binds the configured name, the catch clause is renamed all the same - the name is free in the catch's own scope - and the program still compiles and prints the same

invocations.name: S4
invocations.note: naming local fix: two flagged _adjust locals in sibling blocks are both renamed, a third at body level is declined because the renames claim the name in its scope; the program still compiles and prints the same

invocations.name: R1
invocations.note: a safe fold writes a null-guard ternary that a report-only rule flags, at the rule's default severity and with no project config: the run names the finding it wrote and exits 3

invocations.name: REACH-NO-ORACLE
invocations.note: prefer-split-part would import lib.Text, which the only declared build (-cp . alone) cannot resolve, run under --no-oracle: the fix must be declined, not written

invocations.name: R1
invocations.note: if-false: parentheses nested around the literal are all peeled, so `#if ((false))` is a dead region (read through the condition reader, not a hand skip of one paren layer)

invocations.name: W1
invocations.note: prefer-final-field: a field written through `++ // c` + newline + name is a write, so it is not flagged final; `// ++` + newline + name is no write

invocations.name: R1
invocations.note: prefer-compare-function on a build that cannot read the named function: no finding at its sites, and the rules those sites supersede (redundant-lambda-wrapper, prefer-if-expression-chain) report there

invocations.name: REACH-MAP-AS-SET
invocations.note: map-as-set advises the project set type lib.Set, which the only declared build (-cp src alone) cannot resolve, run under --no-oracle: the finding is withheld, not reported

invocations.name: B1
invocations.note: member-order reorder over the default review budget, applied under --review-budget; the program must print what it printed

invocations.name: IC1
invocations.note: inline-constant --fix drops inline from Strings read only by case patterns (a plain and an abstract-typed constant, an array pattern); the program must print what it printed

invocations.name: TG1
invocations.note: a trigraph in an inline field and an enum-abstract value is a constant the compiler reads: reported, with no edit offered

invocations.name: TG2
invocations.note: a trigraph in a plain field and in an expression is cut into a concatenation that prints the same

invocations.name: TG3
invocations.note: hxcpp compiles Haxe only: a JSON document holding a trigraph draws no finding

invocations.name: RISKY-NOT-CANONICAL
invocations.note: a drifted file under a compiler oracle gets no risky fix and the run names it

invocations.name: Q1
invocations.note: a quotation is read: the asymmetric pair is braced, the pair whose else is the splice $b is left alone

invocations.name: Q2
invocations.note: a quotation is read: the else after an exiting branch is de-nested, the one beside a spliced statement is not

invocations.name: Q3
invocations.note: a metadata-wrapped splice (@:mergeBlock $b{decls};) declares into the enclosing block: the finding stays and the else is not de-nested

invocations.name: PUOSI-INTERP-READ
invocations.note: a `$name` read inside a string keeps the static import: the finding is report-only with its reason, and the oracle has no import deletion to bisect away

invocations.name: PB1
invocations.note: prefer-bind takes a local whose every write precedes the lambda (g param, i sibling loop, k receiver) and keeps the shapes a write can reach after the callback exists: comprehension or do-while or while-condition write each turn, local function called later, closure created in a loop, compound or arm write after, receiver written after

invocations.name: AMBIENT-USING-NO-INSERT
invocations.note: a using the folder's import.hx already supplies is in scope: prefer-exists and prefer-static-extension rewrite and insert no second using

invocations.name: MEMBER-ORDER-ENUM-VALUES
invocations.note: an enum abstract keeps its values first and in source order under member-order --fix, so the auto-numbering the program prints does not change

invocations.name: MEMBER-ORDER-ENUM-VALUES-MIXED
invocations.note: values with mixed visibility, initializers and an #else branch keep their order and numbering under member-order --fix

invocations.name: MEMBER-ORDER-LEGACY-ENUM-VALUES
invocations.note: a legacy @:enum abstract is an enum abstract too: its values are no ordinary fields, member-order reports and moves none of them

invocations.name: PURITY-FIELD-READ-OVERLOADS
invocations.note: a field read on an abstract with only @:arrayAccess or @:op(A + B) stays pure: join-branch-call fires on all three abstracts (base: 1)

invocations.name: PURITY-INTERCEPTOR-DECLARED-NAME
invocations.note: a declared member of an abstract with @:op(a.b) is read directly: join-branch-call fires once

files.D.hx:
abstract WithDot<T>(Array<T>) { public function push(x:T):Int return this.push(x); @:op(a.b) function dot(n:String):Int return 0; }
class D { public static function d(c:Bool, xs:WithDot<Int>) { if (c) xs.push(1); else xs.push(2); } }

invocations.name: D-REDUNDANT-ELSE-REGION-CAPTURE
invocations.note: a local an else body declares must not be lifted out of an #if region over a later read of the field of that name: refused

invocations.name: JB1
invocations.note: join-branch-call over reads the typer must bind: an inherited member's getter field, a map-loop binder's getter and a Dynamic receiver are refused; a static, a map-loop binder's plain field, an inferred local, a nested loop binder and Array.length are joined

files.P.hx: class P { public var x:Int = 0; public var g(get, never):Int; function get_g():Int return 1; public function new() {} }

invocations.name: D-RLW-CTOR
invocations.note: redundant-lambda-wrapper: a lambda reading a field the constructor assigns after it must stay a lambda

invocations.name: U1
invocations.note: a project-root module whose `using` no extension call goes through is a deletable Warning on a narrow lint, and the fix keeps the program compiling

invocations.name: U2
invocations.note: a `using` of a project module that is a typedef of a class brings the class's statics: the extension call keeps it, the fix deletes nothing

invocations.name: RNC1
invocations.note: redundant-narrowing-copy: the copy of a field is reported only where nothing between it and its last use can change the field (the fire* shapes), not past a call, a write, a loop, a getter, an overloaded operator or index, a converting type or an argument (the silent* shapes)

invocations.name: D-RLW-INTERFACE-RECEIVER
invocations.note: redundant-lambda-wrapper: a lambda over a receiver typed by an interface (final field or final local) is not reported, a class-typed final field still is

invocations.name: N1
invocations.note: an oracle declaration that reads to nothing is re-read on every ask: its config diagnostic is said once over the passes, the fixes and the residue lints

invocations.name: D-UNNECESSARY-BLOCK-LATER-READ-CAPTURE
invocations.note: a bare block whose local would capture a later bare read of the field of that name keeps its braces: the unwrap is withheld and the finding stays

invocations.name: D-RLW-FINAL-DECLARATION-BOTH-FILES
invocations.note: a forwarding lambda over a `final class` receiver and its static callee is reported with both files linted

invocations.name: D-RLW-STATIC-CALLEE-ONE-FILE
invocations.note: the same lambdas are reported with only the host file linted: the declaring file answers through the resolution index

invocations.name: D-RLW-STD-NAME-SHADOWED-BY-UNIMPORTED-TYPE
invocations.note: a type of the std name declared in a package the host does not import leaves the callee the std one: the finding is the std arm with or without that file linted

invocations.name: D-JBC-STDLIB-ARGUMENT-JOINS
invocations.note: a Math static, a String method and a StringTools result read shared by both branches are each proven transparent under the std the run resolves, so every branch pair is reported

invocations.name: BMN1
invocations.note: inline-constant on a class implementing an interface whose @:autoBuild sits in an #if region nested in another: the index lifts the nested tag onto the interface, so the implementor is macro-built and declines

files.pkg/Base.hx:
package pkg;
#if a
#if b
@:autoBuild(pkg.B.build())
#end
#end
interface Base {}

invocations.name: BMN2
invocations.note: inline-constant on a class whose own @:build sits in an #if region nested in another: the index lifts the nested tag onto the class, so it declines

invocations.name: IF1
invocations.note: if-false over a #if true region that is the left operand of a binary: the fix must keep the operand after the #end

invocations.name: IF2
invocations.note: if-false over a member region the grammar reads together with the next member: nothing is reported, no member is deleted

invocations.name: RT1
invocations.note: a plain import beside a using of the same module is reported; nothing is written

invocations.name: US-LITERAL-SUBJECT
invocations.note: an empty catch-all statement switch whose literal subject spells `//` is deleted like its plain twin; the one with a real comment is refused

invocations.name: PTE-ARROW-BODY
invocations.note: an arrow lambda expression body and the if statement ending its block body become ternaries, the negation oriented and the trailing comment kept; the program prints the same

invocations.name: MTD-BETWEEN-METAS
invocations.note: a doc written between a class's metadata entries is reported and moved before the first entry; the program still compiles and runs

invocations.name: PD1
invocations.note: prefer-doc-comment: a // run above a #if region holding only metadata documents the type below it (the region is part of the leading run), so it is reported

invocations.name: SB-STRING-MARKER
invocations.note: simplify-boolean-return-chain: a `//` inside a string literal of a guard condition is no comment, so the chain is reduced (a string-blind scan refused it)

invocations.name: F-PTR-ONEPASS
invocations.note: prefer-ternary-return on a pair with a boolean-literal branch writes `c || x` in the one pass: the fixed point, not the ternary simplify-boolean-ternary rewrites next

invocations.name: UI1
invocations.note: unused-import of a library module whose typedef aliases an enum outside the resolution scope, kept alive only by a bare constructor of that enum: the safe --fix must leave it

invocations.name: PLEB-STRING-MARKER
invocations.note: prefer-lambda-expression-body: a `//` inside a string literal on the last interior line of a de-braced lambda is no comment, so the collapse is reported (a string-blind scan refused it) (under the project hxformat.json: the writer must reach the de-brace path)

invocations.name: PLEB-BLOCK-COMMENT-IN-CODE
invocations.note: prefer-lambda-expression-body: a block comment inside the code of the last interior line is not the trailing comment run, so the collapse is still reported (under the project hxformat.json: the writer must reach the de-brace path)

invocations.name: MTO-MAIN-LAST
invocations.note: module-type-order: a typedef written after the main type moves above it under the default mainType last (an engine without the rule answers unknown rule)

invocations.name: MTO-CROSS-REGION-NAMES-GUARDED
invocations.note: module-type-order: the main type under #if js with a top-level typedef after it is not moved, and --verbose names the guarded class A as the reason, never the top-level typedef

invocations.name: PH-IMPORT-RIDES-ON-REWRITE
invocations.note: prefer-helper's only rewrite (a findMap whose lambda loses the narrowing of o) is rejected by the oracle: the import it needed must go with it, leaving the file untouched

invocations.name: PH-EXTENSION-FORM-MIXED-MODULES
invocations.note: prefer-helper with one listed and one unlisted helper module in a body: the listed one becomes an extension call with a using, the unlisted one stays qualified with an import, and the program still prints the same list

invocations.name: F-STEP
invocations.note: the four step-in-condition counter forms with untouched statements between and a negated literal init: fixed to range loops that print the same

invocations.name: D-STEP-SHADOW
invocations.note: the initializer names a variable a between statement re-declares: evaluated at the while it would read the inner one, so the loop is refused

invocations.name: MAP1
invocations.note: a plain map fill folds, a filtered one keeps its if

invocations.name: MAP2
invocations.note: map fills whose value or key the typing does not prove exactly the declared map type (Float, base class, null, lambda, ternary, cast, untyped) stay loops, the proven ones fold, and the file keeps printing the same

invocations.name: MAP3
invocations.note: map fills whose operands the typing proves (a compound-assignment value, a negated key) fold and compile; an assignment key, an abstract key and an empty iterable stay loops

invocations.name: MAP4
invocations.note: a cast key the typing cannot prove stays the loop, never spliced bare

invocations.name: UPM-STATIC-FIELDS
invocations.note: unused-public-member reports an unreferenced public static field and nothing else a field can be: a read one, an instance, a private static, one only some builds make public, an enum abstract value, a property (once, its accessor left alone)

invocations.name: NGL1
invocations.note: prefer-null-guarded-loop under an oracle: a plain field chain is rewritten to the guard; a getter-backed value and a loop an else follows are reported and kept

invocations.name: ATD-NAMED-TYPEDEF
invocations.note: anon-type-dup with a named structure: the typedef module is created in its package, imports the field type the first occurrence reaches through its own package with no import written, and an occurrence inside the typedef package gets the short name with no import of it; the result compiles

invocations.name: PAC-MEMBERSHIP
invocations.note: prefer-array-contains rewrites every indexOf not-found comparison over a proved Array (both sides, nested in the value, under !, &&, a ternary condition, == true) and leaves typedef aliases of String-like, abstracts over Array, String, Dynamic, Null<Array>, comprehensions and <= -1 alone; the fixed program compiles and prints what it printed

invocations.name: PET-TYPE-PARAM-SHADOW
invocations.note: prefer-existing-typedef leaves a structure alone whose type name is a type parameter of the enclosing class: the typedef's Foo is the class pkg.Foo, the parameter outranks it, and the fix would change the type

invocations.name: PET-NESTED-STRUCTURE
invocations.note: prefer-existing-typedef plans only the outer of two nested fixable structures, so the file's edit group applies (User.hx becomes f():Outer with its import) instead of the whole component being skipped

invocations.name: F-JR-LAMBDA-RESTATED
invocations.note: an annotated local returned from an untyped lambda whose parameter type returns the same type: joined without the ascription

invocations.name: F-JR-LAMBDA-UNBOUND-PARAM
invocations.note: a generic caller T annotation under a same-file callee type parameter the call does not bind: joined keeping the ascription

invocations.name: J1
invocations.note: jvm-short-circuit-inline-local-fn: warns on the call in the right operand of || (repro), not inside a function literal or the right operand of ??

invocations.name: HW1
invocations.note: prefer-typed-throw: a blocking catch clause written as code inside a string-interpolation hole still degrades the thrower to report-only

invocations.name: HW2
invocations.note: prefer-typed-throw: a blocking catch clause that only a comment spells is no handler, so the thrower is not degraded to report-only

invocations.name: RO1
invocations.note: registry order: guard-return runs after prefer-ternary-return, so a nested if/else of returns in an override settles as one if-expression return, not flat guard returns

invocations.name: RO2
invocations.note: registry order: redundant-else-after-return runs before prefer-switch, so an if / else-if chain of guard blocks on one length settles as flat guards, not a switch with an empty default

invocations.name: RO3
invocations.note: registry order: redundant-else-after-return runs before collapsible-else-if and hoist-common-branch-head, so twin locals of an if/else stay in their branches and a nested if/else of returns settles as ternary returns

invocations.name: X1
invocations.note: an anon-type-dup group anchored at a file its excludePaths scopes out is reported once, at an in-scope occurrence
